title: No
text: "No. We are sorry. We have watched how you treat what is not yours, and they are safer here."

choices.label: "Then I'll take them."
choices.reply: To break them out, order your units onto the pen's guards. Engram will remember it.

choices.label: Leave them for now
choices.reply: "Thank you. They are fed. They are warm. We will look after them until you are someone else."

notes: Engram counter ≤ 0: only force frees them (attack the pen-guard encounter; pen-broken).
